question: Analyze the binding interface between a protein and DNA molecules in a PDB structure. List protein residues within 4.0 Angstroms of any DNA atom, and DNA nucleotides within 4.0 Angstroms of any protein atom.

expected_output.guidelines: Exact set of (type, chain, ID, name) records must match the reference for both protein residues and DNA nucleotides; type-label case and column names may differ; row order may differ.
